'''''Cularin 1''''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that was used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was originally called the '''''Nimbus''''' and used by the [[Thaereian military]], but it was captured by the [[Cularin Militia]] and they renamed it and put it into service with their fleet. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] planned the Militia's [[Battle of Dorumaa|attack]] on the Thaereian military's [[Dorumaa Base|base]] on [[Dorumaa]] while aboard it. The ''Cularin 1'' later served as the Militia's flagship during the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Inside-out: Storm's Depths|Storm's Depths]]'', the ''Nimbus'' is referred to as being a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian gunship]], whereas ''[[Decision: Cularin]]'' identifies the ''Cularin 1'' as a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]].
